open_points.subject: activate_flow_version
open_points.text: - activate_flow_version: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise UnknownReferenceError for an unknown flow version; then prove it again with prove_version and raise RefusedError carrying the proof failure when it is not proven; then raise RefusedError when the actor is an agent and highest_effect_class is above read, even when that version is already active, keeping nothing.
open_points.other_text: - activate_flow_version: [BEHAVIOR] When the version already is its flow's latest activation it returns that FlowActivation and records nothing; otherwise it writes one ActivateFlowVersionChange through record_change with the proven highest_effect_class and activated_at from kernel_now, under the kernel actor when that class is read and under the given owner actor otherwise, which replaces the previous activation at once while started runs keep their pinned version.
open_points.question: When an above-read version is already active and the actor is an agent, must the function raise RefusedError or return the existing FlowActivation?

open_points.subject: compose_flow_version
open_points.text: - compose_flow_version: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] Each constant becomes a StoredValue of value carriage with the declared value_schema and disclosure class, value_digest the content_identity of its bytes and value_id the content_identity of its StoredValueContent, its bytes stored with put_value_bytes, and a FlowConstant naming that value_id.
open_points.other_text: - compose_flow_version: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] flow_version_id is content_identity of the FlowVersionContent; when a flow version with that identity exists it is returned unchanged and nothing is written, otherwise one ComposeFlowVersionChange is written through record_change with authored_at from kernel_now, the given actor, and created_flow_purpose set only when the flow is new.
open_points.question: When an equal flow version already exists, must put_value_bytes still store every constant's bytes, or must nothing be written?
